entities.name: 5GS synchronization
entities.description: Synchronization process where lower layers provide the 5G internal system clock via NG-RAN, and the UE forwards this clock to DS-TT(s).

entities.name: (g)PTP domain synchronization
entities.description: Synchronization process where the UE forwards (g)PTP messages between the PDU session and DS-TT(s) associated with the PDU session.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE forwards synchronization information (5G internal system clock or (g)PTP messages) between network elements and DS-TT(s).

entities.name: DS-TT
entities.description: Device-side time-sensitive networking translator that receives synchronization information (5G internal system clock or (g)PTP messages) from the UE.

entities.name: NG-RAN
entities.description: Next Generation Radio Access Network that provides the 5G internal system clock for 5GS synchronization.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: Protocol Data Unit session used for forwarding (g)PTP messages between the UE and DS-TT(s).

entities.name: 5G internal system clock
entities.description: System clock provided by lower layers via NG-RAN and forwarded by the UE to DS-TT(s) for 5GS synchronization.

entities.name: (g)PTP messages
entities.description: Precision Time Protocol messages used for (g)PTP domain synchronization, forwarded between PDU session and DS-TT(s) by the UE.

relations.description: 5GS synchronization involves using the 5G internal system clock provided via NG-RAN.
The UE forwards the 5G internal system clock to DS-TT(s) as part of 5GS synchronization.
(g)PTP domain synchronization involves forwarding (g)PTP messages between PDU session and DS-TT(s).
The UE forwards synchronization information (clock or messages) to DS-TT(s).
NG-RAN provides the 5G internal system clock for 5GS synchronization.
(g)PTP messages are transmitted via the PDU session for (g)PTP domain synchronization.
